<translated_code>
import math

def main():
    x, y, n = map(float, input().split())
    n = int(n)

    target = x / y
    best_error = 1e18
    best_a = 0
    best_b = 1

    for b in range(1, n + 1):
        val = b * target
        candidates = [math.floor(val), math.ceil(val)]

        for candidate in candidates:
            error = abs(target - candidate / b)
            if error < best_error:
                best_error = error
                best_a = int(candidate)
                best_b = b

    print(f"{best_a}/{best_b}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
